_comment_hooks: Hook commands invoke _dispatch.py via a small Python bootstrap that walks up from cwd to find .claude/harness/. This replaces the POSIX while-loop and is cross-platform (Mac/Linux/WSL/Git-Bash/Windows native).
_bootstrap: python3 -c "import pathlib,sys,subprocess; p=pathlib.Path.cwd(); r=next((a for a in [p,*p.parents] if (a/'.claude/harness').is_dir()),None); sys.exit(0) if not r else sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(r/'.claude/harness/_dispatch.py'),sys.argv[1]],stdin=sys.stdin).returncode)"

PreToolUse._comment_hook_ordering: sdd-wip-guard is in a separate Write-only block (index 4 in PreToolUse array). path-existence-guard is in the Edit|Write|Read block (index 2). Ordering assumption: Claude Code processes PreToolUse blocks in array order within a single tool event, so path-existence-guard fires before sdd-wip-guard for Write calls. This is an architectural assumption — not guaranteed by the public schema. If Claude Code changes to parallel block execution, move sdd-wip-guard into the Edit|Write|Read block after path-existence-guard.
